title: Sources: Shanghai-based Pragmatik Labs, founded by ex-Qwen AI head Junyang Lin, raised tens of millions of dollars at a $5B valuation, up from $2B in August (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Sources: Shanghai-based Pragmatik Labs, founded by ex-Qwen AI head Junyang Lin, raised tens of millions of dollars at a $5B valuation, up from $2B in August — A startup founded by Alibaba Group Holding Ltd.'s former AI chief has closed new funding at a valuation of $5 billion …
